# Darwin Core Text metafile XSD

Official upstream: https://github.com/tdwg/dwc/blob/master/docs/text/tdwg_dwc_text.xsd

This file is an unmodified copy of the TDWG metafile schema. Its external
imports are not referenced by the metafile types and do not need to be
fetched for offline lxml XMLSchema validation. The manifest records the
local XSD SHA-256.
